The swimming pool has become an important part of daily life. Grace plans to study music harder this term. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Compare the two phones before choosing.
Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. Little by little, things began to change. Grace wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Cyclists spun easily across the endless flatland.

Grace usually spends the weekend reading at the zoo. The climbing wall looked quieter than usual that evening. The experience taught Grace more than any book could. Salted peanuts disappeared quickly at the office party.
There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Grace believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
